description:
Lossless Frame Generation is now available on Android — and it actually works. 
In this video I'm testing out LSFG Android, an app that brings Vulkan-based 
frame generation to your phone or tablet. No root required. We go through the 
full setup, settings, and then put it to the test with Cyberpunk 2077 on Android
